description: This file contains various functions for extracting, processing, and patching calibration data in firmware images. It includes methods for reading data from different device partitions, handling calibration data files, and patching firmware with MAC addresses and checksum adjustments.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs a dd operation to copy data from a source to a target with specified byte size and offset.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a partition using the appropriate device and writes it to firmware.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Extracts calibration data in reverse byte order and writes it to firmware.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Copies calibration data from a file or device source to firmware.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data from a file into sysfs directory.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Validates calibration data by checking the magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_chksum
methods.description: Patches the checksum in the calibration data with a MAC address.

methods.name: caldata_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches a MAC address into the calibration data and updates checksum.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Wrapper to patch MAC address for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches MAC address and checksum for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Wrapper to patch MAC address for ath10k devices.
